description:
Get detailed interaction evidence for a target.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table interaction_evidence — one record = one interaction evidence record (one experiment or curated statement) for one interactor pair.
Key: interactionIdentifier, intA, intB, targetA, targetB (interactionIdentifier and targetA and targetB may be null).
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.pair` counts pairs; `_vbt.grains.experiment` counts experiments.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Evidence records behind OT 25.09 interactions; absence means no record in these sources.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
